messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick postmortem follow-up — last week's delayed token ingestion caused a late usage bump and a handful of invoice corrections. Need to lock owners and timelines for remediation and customer outreach.
Sanjay Patel: I can take the streaming consumer fix. Root cause looks like backpressure + a checkpoint race. Expect a hotfix in ~48h, followed by a safe backfill plan.
Liam O'Connor: Once you have the sequence ranges I'll run an accounting diff to confirm no double-count or drops. Also want to validate KV cache interactions.
Alex Chen: Billing ops — I need the exact affected invoice ids and token deltas before we craft credits. Can someone produce a list? I can prepare a provisional credit file.
Maria Gomez: Action plan proposal below. Please ack and adjust ETAs: 1) Engineering patch + monitoring (owner: Sanjay) 2) Backfill run + verification (Sanjay + Liam) 3) Invoice extraction & provisional credits (Alex) 4) Customer comms + support playbook (Julie) 5) Postmortem doc and exec note (Maria)
Julie Park: I'll draft the customer message template once we have the estimated $ impact. Recommend waiting for Alex's list before sending anything public.
billing-bot: Incident INC-4723 created (severity: P2) — tagged finance, eng-infra.
Sanjay Patel: Quick note: the consumer fix includes a conservative throttle and a checkpoint guard. Rolling to canary tomorrow morning. If canary is green, full roll within 24h.
Alex Chen: To speed things up, here's a query I ran locally to surface candidates. We'll need to run it against prod snapshots: 
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_sum, MIN(ingest_ts) as first_ts, MAX(ingest_ts) as last_ts
FROM token_ledger
WHERE ingest_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-11T23:59:59Z'
  AND source = 'consumer-v2'
GROUP BY invoice_id, customer_id
HAVING tokens_sum > 0
ORDER BY tokens_sum DESC;
```
Alex Chen: I'll run this after Sanjay confirms the exact sequence ranges to avoid false positives.
Liam O'Connor: For verification I'll compare the ledger baseline (pre-incident) vs. post-ingest with a script that validates per-customer token counts + reconciles embeddings usage.
Maria Gomez: Timeline expectations: patch canary 24h, full patch 48h, backfill planning 72h, first invoice list within 5 business days, credits and customer comms within 7-10 business days depending on scope.
Sanjay Patel: Ack. Two risks: backfill could spike CPU on the ingestion cluster and cause transient lag. I'll include rate-limiting knobs and a dry-run mode.
Alex Chen: For transparency, I'll also prepare a CSV with columns: invoice_id, customer_id, tokens_before, tokens_after, token_delta, suggested_credit_usd.
Julie Park: Support playbook items: hold messaging for high-value customers until we have exact numbers; offer expedited manual credits for impacted enterprise customers.
Maria Gomez: Recurring pattern note: this is the third ingestion lag we've seen in 9 months — need a follow-on workstream to look at retention GC and checkpointing. Adding as separate epic item.
Liam O'Connor: Agreed. I can take the lead on a short-term mitigation audit (3 sprints) to harden checkpoint logic and add unit/integration tests around GC interaction.
Sanjay Patel: I'll add monitoring and a dedicated alert for consumer queue lag > 5m and checkpoint latency > 500ms.
Alex Chen: Once I have the invoice CSV I'll run a runbook to apply provisional credits and tag the journal entries with "INGEST-BACKFILL-INC-4723" for traceability.
Maria Gomez: Can everyone confirm owners/ETAs here in-thread? We want a single source of truth for the next update.
Sanjay Patel: Owner: engineering consumer fix & backfill orchestration. Canary tomorrow AM, full roll 48h.
Liam O'Connor: Owner: reconciliation & accuracy validation. First reconciliation report 72h after backfill.
Alex Chen: Owner: invoice extraction + provisional credits. Will deliver invoice CSV within 5 business days from now.
Julie Park: Owner: customer comms + support playbook. Draft ready once Alex shares numbers — target 7 business days.
Maria Gomez: I'll own the postmortem doc and exec summary. First pass sent to @all in 3 business days.
billing-bot: Reminder set: follow-up sync scheduled in 3 days (channel: #finance).
Alex Chen: One more ask — please tag any manual journal entries with internal note linking to INC-4723 and the backfill run id. Makes audits easier.
Maria Gomez: Thanks everyone. I'll compile these owners into the postmortem action table and add follow-up dates. If no objections, we'll meet for a 30min sync tomorrow 11:00am PT.
Julie Park: Works for me.
Sanjay Patel: I'll be there.
Liam O'Connor: Same.
Alex Chen: Confirmed.
Maria Gomez: Closing thread for now — updates will be posted in #finance and the doc in the postmortem folder. :eyes:
